about: The licence texts B1's data packages ship (scripts/lib/licence-texts.mjs; docs/DESIGN.md#engine-and-data). Each data package's LICENSES/ holds the texts its packages' licences require, and LICENSES/INDEX lists each package with its files. 'texts' are the licence texts by id: a file in this repository with its pinned SHA-256, or a file in a package's archive in the pinned snapshot, which the archive's SHA-512 vouches for. 'keys' gives each Catalogue licence the texts it needs; 'own' adds the package's own licence files (an OFL font's copyright notice and Reserved Font Names, an MIT or BSD notice); 'terms' marks a licence with no common text, whose terms must be found in the package's licence files or in its own TeX files. '(none)' is a package with no Catalogue licence: TeX Live's own files. 'packages' names packages whose files carry a licence the Catalogue does not name. 'readings' records packages whose terms a person read in their shipped files. A licence with no rule here, a missing text, and a package whose own text or terms are not found stop the build.

LPPL-1.3c.source: https://www.latex-project.org/lppl/lppl-1-3c.txt (the LaTeX Project's own text, as the other LPPL versions here), 2026-10-26. SPDX's copy differs in its appendix (the 1.3 example), and the LPPL allows only verbatim copies of itself. The one LPPL 1.3c file of the repository, which the main package ships too

GUST-Font-License.source: doc/fonts/lm/GUST-FONT-LICENSE.TXT in lm's doc archive of the 2026/10/15 snapshot (the archive checked against the tlpdb's SHA-512)

GPL-3.0.source: liveMd2Tex's own LICENSE: the Free Software Foundation's GPL-3.0 text

CC0-1.0.source: Creative Commons' plain text, https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode.txt, byte for byte the same as SPDX licence list v3.27.0, text/CC0-1.0.txt, 2026-10-26

IBM-Courier.source: IBM's Courier notice as X.Org ships it with the same fonts: COPYING of xorg/font/ibm-type1 (gitlab.freedesktop.org, tag font-ibm-type1-1.0.4 and master), 2026-10-26

Knuth.source: CTAN's explanation of the Knuth License, https://ctan.org/license/knuth, 2026-10-26, with a line that names it, and Knuth's own words from plain.tex

MakeIndex.source: MakeIndex's distribution notice, texk/makeindexk/COPYING in TeX Live's source tree at tag texlive-2026.0 (github.com/TeX-Live/texlive-source, branch tags/texlive-2026.0), the source TeXlyre build 46ebb62 compiles, 2026-10-26; the main extension ships it too, for the MakeIndex in the engine

ICU.source: ICU's LICENSE (the Unicode License V3 and the third-party notices), libs/icu/icu-src/LICENSE in TeX Live's source tree at tag texlive-2026.0 (ICU 78.2), which TeXlyre build 46ebb62 compiles; the same in unicode-org/icu releases 78.1 and 78.2, 2026-10-26

TeX-Live-LICENSE.TL.source: TeX Live's own licence statement, in texlive.infra's archive

TeX-Live-LICENSE.CTAN.source: TeX Live's note on CTAN's licences, in texlive.infra's archive

lppl.note: the Catalogue names no version: the current one

gfl.note: the GUST Font License is the LPPL 1.3c or later with one request; the package's own MANIFEST files list the fonts it covers

gpl.note: the Catalogue names no version: both

lgpl.note: no version named; the LGPL 3.0 adds to the GPL 3.0

apache2.note: own: a package's NOTICE file goes with it (Apache-2.0 section 4(d)); ktbox has one

bsd.note: a BSD licence whose clauses the Catalogue does not give: its text must be in the package

knuth.note: CTAN's statement of Knuth's terms; many of the files state them too

other-free.note: a free licence the Catalogue does not name: its text must be in the package

(none).note: no Catalogue entry: TeX Live's own files, under TeX Live's terms

dejavu.reason: its fonts carry the Bitstream Vera and Arev terms, which the Catalogue's licence (lppl1.3) does not name

makeindex.reason: its index styles state no terms, and its doc archive holds none; MakeIndex's notice is in TeX Live's sources (read 2026-10-26)

kastrup.read: binhex.tex, which ships, says to see the source file for the copyright, and may be passed on only with its sources; binhex.dtx: 'Any use of the code is permitted as long as this copyright notice is preserved in the code.' Read 2026-10-26 in the pinned snapshot's source archive (t1c gate, T1S-03).

plweb.read: pl.sty and pcode.sty, which ship, say to see the source file; pl.dtx and pl.ins: 'Everyone is granted permission to copy, modify and redistribute pl.dtx, provided this copyright notice is preserved and any modifications are indicated.' Read 2026-10-26 in the pinned snapshot's source archive (T1S-03).

menu.read: README: 'License type: LaTeX Project Public License', with no version; menu.sty states nothing. Read 2026-10-26 (T1S-06).

fancynum.read: README: the LaTeX Project Public License, 'Either version 1.0 or, at your option, any later version.' Read 2026-10-26 (T1S-06).

beamertheme-metropolis.read: README and its .sty files: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International. Read 2026-10-26 (T1S-06).

tucv.read: tucv.sty and README: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported. Read 2026-10-26 (T1S-06).

tugboat-plain.read: Both files: unlimited copying and redistribution if unmodified; modified versions only under another file name (the licence review of 2026-10-22; T1S-06).

hyphen-basque.read: The loader: 'You may freely use, modify and/or distribute this file'; the patterns carry their own permissive licence in their header (T1S-06).

colorprofiles.read: README: the TeX files under the LPPL 1.2 or any later version; the other terms it names are given in full in the README. Read 2026-10-26.

docutils.read: README: 'Released under the terms of the 2-Clause BSD license'. Read 2026-10-26.

dvips.read: README: Tom Rokicki's original files are public domain; the rest is under the GNU General Public License (see the files COPYING*). Read 2026-10-26.

fontTerms.about: Each Type 1 font's terms, from its own header (scripts/lib/licence-texts.mjs, classifyFonts; the t1c gate, T1S-01). The first class whose 'match' matches, unless its 'unless' matches too, is the font's; 'reference' marks a header that points to its package's licence; a header with neither states nothing. A font is packed with t1c only when its class is lppl, gpl or vera; any other is stored as it is, with the reason. 'texts' are the licence texts a font of that class adds to its package; 'extract' writes the notices its header states into the package's LICENSES folder.

classes.reason: its header names the SIL Open Font License, or a font under it (STIX, EB Garamond), and the OFL counts a change of format as a Modified Version

classes.reason: IBM's Courier terms: X.Org's copy of them grants copying and distribution, and names no changes
its header names the Apache License, whose terms were not read for a stored form
its header says it derives from another font and does not state the terms
its header puts it in the public domain; only fonts under the LPPL, the GUST Font License or the GPL are packed

fontTerms.unclear: its header states no licence, and other fonts of its package state different terms
fontTerms.unread: its header states no licence, and its package's licence is not the LPPL, the GUST Font License or the GPL

engineFiles.about: The files core-data takes from the engine build's pinned image (scripts/lib/bundle.mjs, engineSupportFiles), by path: the texts they need. A file no pattern matches stops the build.

^texlive/icudt\\d+l\\.dat$.note: ICU's data (ICU 78.2), which XeTeX reads; its source: libs/icu in TeX Live's source tree at tag texlive-2026.0, https://github.com/TeX-Live/texlive-source/tree/tags/texlive-2026.0/libs/icu

^texlive/tex/(generic|latex)/tex-ini-fil.note: TeX Live's tex-ini-files, which the Catalogue gives as public domain

^texlive/tex/latex/latexconfig/.note: TeX Live's latexconfig, which has no Catalogue licence: TeX Live's own files
